+"""Independently audit both full native softmax output streams against CPU data."""
+
+import argparse
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+
+
+def sha(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for data in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            h.update(data)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def manifest(directory, nested=False):
+    value = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text())
+    records = value["files"] if nested else value
+    for name, expected in records.items():
+        path = Path(name)
+        if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or sha(directory / path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("Artifact path/hash mismatch: " + name)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--device-output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    data, device, out = args.input.resolve(), args.device_output.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
+    manifest(data, True)
+    manifest(device)
+    metadata = json.loads((data / "dataset.json").read_text())
+    runtime = json.loads((device / "results.json").read_text())
+    expected_trials = sum(len(c["trials"]) for c in metadata["cases"])
+    if (runtime["status"] != "runtime-checks-passed-pending-independent-numerical-audit"
+            or runtime["input_manifest_sha256"] != sha(data / "manifest.json")
+            or runtime["trials"] != expected_trials or runtime["launches"] != 2 * expected_trials
+            or runtime["runner_sha256"] != sha(data / "run_gpu.py")
+            or not all(r["all_allocation_guards_unchanged"] and r["input_unchanged"] for r in runtime["cases"])):
+        raise ValueError("Unexpected runtime record")
+    import numpy as np
+
+    total = sum(c["elements"] * len(c["trials"]) for c in metadata["cases"])
+    streams = {name: np.memmap(path, dtype="<f2", mode="r") for name, path in {
+        "reference": data / "expected.bin", "racy-output": device / "racy-output.bin",
+        "fixed-output": device / "fixed-output.bin",
+    }.items()}
+    if any(values.size != total for values in streams.values()):
+        raise ValueError("Output/reference element count differs")
+    methods = {name: {"comparisons": 0, "failed": 0, "nonfinite": 0, "max_abs_error": 0., "max_rel_error": 0.}
+               for name in ("racy-output", "fixed-output")}
+    records, paired_bit_differences = [], 0
+    for case in metadata["cases"]:
+        n = case["elements"]
+        for trial in case["trials"]:
+            offset = trial["offset_elements"]
+            ref = streams["reference"][offset:offset+n]
+            if hashlib.sha256(ref.tobytes()).hexdigest() != trial["expected_sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError("Trial reference hash differs")
+            item = {"rows": case["rows"], "trial": trial["trial"], "family": trial["family"],
+                    "elements": n, "methods": {}, "paired_bit_differences": 0}
+            for start in range(0, n, 131072):
+                stop = min(n, start + 131072)
+                expected = ref[start:stop].astype(np.float64)
+                for name, counts in methods.items():
+                    actual = streams[name][offset+start:offset+stop].astype(np.float64)
+                    finite = np.isfinite(actual)
+                    absolute = np.abs(actual - expected)
+                    failures = ~finite | (absolute > metadata["atol"] + metadata["rtol"] * np.abs(expected))
+                    relative = np.divide(absolute, np.abs(expected), out=np.zeros_like(absolute), where=expected != 0)
+                    found = int(failures.sum())
+                    counts["comparisons"] += stop - start
+                    counts["failed"] += found
+                    counts["nonfinite"] += int((~finite).sum())
+                    counts["max_abs_error"] = max(counts["max_abs_error"], float(np.max(absolute)))
+                    counts["max_rel_error"] = max(counts["max_rel_error"], float(np.max(relative)))
+                    item["methods"].setdefault(name, {"comparisons": 0, "failed": 0})
+                    item["methods"][name]["comparisons"] += stop - start
+                    item["methods"][name]["failed"] += found
+                a = streams["racy-output"][offset+start:offset+stop].view("<u2")
+                b = streams["fixed-output"][offset+start:offset+stop].view("<u2")
+                item["paired_bit_differences"] += int((a != b).sum())
+            paired_bit_differences += item["paired_bit_differences"]
+            records.append(item)
+    passed = all(v["failed"] == 0 and v["nonfinite"] == 0 and v["comparisons"] == total for v in methods.values())
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    report = {
+        "schema": 1, "status": "full-native-softmax-numerical-checks-passed" if passed else "numerical-mismatch",
+        "checked_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "device": runtime["device"],
+        "numpy": np.__version__, "trials": expected_trials, "launches": 2 * expected_trials,
+        "atol": metadata["atol"], "rtol": metadata["rtol"], "reference": metadata["reference"],
+        "methods": methods, "paired_bit_differences": paired_bit_differences,

+        "original_source_race_free": False, "repair_universal_race_freedom_proved": False,
+        "ieee_equivalence_proved": False, "floating_point_error_bound_proved": False,
+        "original_paper_fully_reproduced": False, "model_calls": 0, "records": records,
+        "scope": "Finite paired AMD numerical trials of independent full three-pass FP16 sources. Each method is compared independently with CPU-float64 stable softmax rounded to FP16 at the end. The original clamped-load source has a source-level race; agreement on this finite sample does not establish race freedom or a universal equality theorem. Historical models, original adapted text and NVIDIA timings are not reproduced.",
+    }
+    (out / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+    shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), out / "auditor.py")
+    (out / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({p.name: sha(p) for p in sorted(out.iterdir()) if p.is_file()}, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps({"status": report["status"], "comparisons_per_method": total,
+                      "failed": sum(v["failed"] for v in methods.values()), "paired_bit_differences": paired_bit_differences}))
+    if not passed:
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Freeze numerical metadata and losslessly deduplicate the four device streams.
+
+Large input/output payloads are separate release assets, keeping Git checkouts
+small. Original per-host manifests and all source/compiler artifacts remain
+unchanged and are fully reconstructed by restore_gpu.py.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import gzip
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import tarfile
+
+from audit_gpu import manifest, sha
+
+
+def archive_files(directory, destination, excluded):
+    with tarfile.open(destination, "w:gz") as archive:
+        for path in sorted(directory.rglob("*")):
+            if path.is_file() and str(path.relative_to(directory)) not in excluded:
+                info = archive.gettarinfo(str(path), arcname=str(path.relative_to(directory)))
+                info.uid = info.gid = info.mtime = 0
+                info.uname = info.gname = ""
+                with path.open("rb") as stream:
+                    archive.addfile(info, stream)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--input-archive", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--mi350", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--mi350-2", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--mi350-audit", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--mi350-2-audit", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--assets", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    data, out, assets = args.input.resolve(), args.output.resolve(), args.assets.resolve()
+    manifest(data, True)
+    devices = {"mi350": args.mi350.resolve(), "mi350-2": args.mi350_2.resolve()}
+    audits = {"mi350": args.mi350_audit.resolve(), "mi350-2": args.mi350_2_audit.resolve()}
+    hashes = set()
+    for host, directory in devices.items():
+        manifest(directory)
+        manifest(audits[host])
+        report = json.loads((audits[host] / "results.json").read_text())
+        if report["status"] != "full-native-softmax-numerical-checks-passed" or report["paired_bit_differences"]:
+            raise ValueError("Numerical audit not passed/bit-identical: " + host)
+        for name in ("racy-output.bin", "fixed-output.bin"):
+            hashes.add(sha(directory / name))
+    if len(hashes) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("This lossless archive layout requires four identical output streams")
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    assets.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    input_asset = assets / (args.label + "-input.tar.gz")
+    if input_asset.exists():
+        raise ValueError("Input asset already exists")
+    os.link(args.input_archive.resolve(), input_asset)
+    output_asset = assets / (args.label + "-output.bin.gz")
+    with output_asset.open("xb") as raw:
+        with gzip.GzipFile(filename="", fileobj=raw, mode="wb", mtime=0) as stream:
+            with (devices["mi350"] / "racy-output.bin").open("rb") as source:
+                shutil.copyfileobj(source, stream, length=1024 * 1024)
+    input_meta = out / "input"
+    input_meta.mkdir()
+    archive_files(data, input_meta / "files.tar.gz", {"input.bin", "expected.bin"})
+    shutil.copyfile(data / "manifest.json", input_meta / "original-manifest.json")
+    shutil.copyfile(data / "dataset.json", input_meta / "dataset.json")
+    summaries = {}
+    for host, directory in devices.items():
+        dest = out / host
+        dest.mkdir()
+        archive_files(directory, dest / "runtime.tar.gz", {"racy-output.bin", "fixed-output.bin"})
+        shutil.copytree(audits[host], dest / "audit")
+        shutil.copyfile(directory / "results.json", dest / "runtime.json")
+        summaries[host] = json.loads((audits[host] / "results.json").read_text())
+    for name in ("restore_gpu.py", "audit_gpu.py"):
+        shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__).with_name(name), out / name)
+    shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), out / "freezer.py")
+    metadata = json.loads((data / "dataset.json").read_text())
+    records = {
+        "input": {"filename": input_asset.name, "sha256": sha(input_asset), "bytes": input_asset.stat().st_size},
+        "output": {"filename": output_asset.name, "sha256": sha(output_asset), "bytes": output_asset.stat().st_size,
+                   "raw_sha256": next(iter(hashes)), "raw_bytes": (devices["mi350"] / "racy-output.bin").stat().st_size},
+    }
+    for asset in records.values():
+        if asset["bytes"] >= 2 * 1024 ** 3:
+            raise ValueError("Release asset exceeds2GiB; split before publishing")
+    report = {
+        "schema": 1, "status": "native-softmax-numerical-artifacts-frozen", "label": args.label,
+        "assets": records, "rows": [c["rows"] for c in metadata["cases"]],
+        "input_manifest_sha256": sha(data / "manifest.json"),
+        "four_device_streams_losslessly_deduplicated": True,
+        "comparisons_per_host": {host: sum(m["comparisons"] for m in r["methods"].values()) for host, r in summaries.items()},
+        "numerical_failures": sum(m["failed"] for r in summaries.values() for m in r["methods"].values()),
+        "paired_trials_per_host": {host: r["trials"] for host, r in summaries.items()},
+        "whole_kernel_lean_execution_proved": False, "source_certificates": 0,
+        "original_source_race_free": False, "repair_universal_race_freedom_proved": False,
+        "ieee_equivalence_proved": False, "floating_point_error_bound_proved": False,
+        "original_paper_fully_reproduced": False, "model_calls": 0,
+    }
+    (out / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+    (out / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({str(p.relative_to(out)): sha(p)
+                                                   for p in sorted(out.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps({"label": args.label, "assets": records, "failures": report["numerical_failures"]}))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Restore every frozen GPU input/output byte from metadata and release assets."""

+import argparse
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import shutil
+import tarfile
+
+
+def sha(path):
+    result = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            result.update(part)
+    return result.hexdigest()
+
+
+def extract(archive_path, directory):
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    seen = set()
+    with tarfile.open(archive_path) as archive:
+        for member in archive:
+            if member.isdir():
+                continue
+            rel = PurePosixPath(member.name)
+            if (not member.isfile() or rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts
+                    or ".git" in rel.parts or member.name in seen):
+                raise ValueError("Unsafe archive entry")
+            seen.add(member.name)
+            target = directory / rel
+            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            with archive.extractfile(member) as source, target.open("wb") as output:
+                shutil.copyfileobj(source, output, length=1024 * 1024)
+
+
+def check_manifest(directory, nested=False):
+    records = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text())
+    if nested:
+        records = records["files"]
+    for name, expected in records.items():
+        p = PurePosixPath(name)
+        if p.is_absolute() or ".." in p.parts or sha(directory / p) != expected:
+            raise ValueError("Restored artifact path/hash differs: " + name)
+
+
+def main():
